description:
Brand Introduction:

SIC69, is a London-based jewellery brand, born in the historic Hatton Garden district, renowned for its high-quality craftsmanship and heritage in jewellery making. Inspired by the mystery and beauty of numbers, SIC69 pieces are uniquely designed to resonate personally with the wearer, combining aesthetic charm with symbolic meaning.

Product Description:

SIC69 offers handcrafted jewellery made with ethically sourced precious stones and metals. Each piece is crafted with care in Hatton Garden and created using a special numeral design—adding a hidden personal meaning that is both visible and private, only understood by those who wear it.

 USP (Unique Selling Point)

1. Handmade in London’s Hatton Garden – Crafted with precision and a dedication to quality in the heart of London’s historic jewellery district.

2. Ethically Sourced Materials – Certified precious stones and metals are used, ensuring sustainability and quality.

3. Numerical Design Philosophy – Each piece embodies a secret numerical system, adding a personal, hidden meaning for the wearer.

Payment Terms:

Commission-Based: Affiliates earn a percentage of sales 10% - 20% generated through their unique referral links. Specific commission rates and payout schedules will be provided upon joining the program.

Payout Method: Payments will be issued monthly through direct deposit or PayPal, based on performance.

Other Information:

Production Time: Each item is custom-made, with a production time of 1–2 weeks to ensure quality and attention to detail.

Target Audience: Ideal for customers who appreciate symbolism, synchronicity, and the intersection of art with personal meaning.

Marketing Support: Affiliates will receive branded materials, high-quality images, and suggested captions to support promotion.
payout_period: Approved commissions are reviewed monthly and paid on the 15th of each month, once referred orders have been confirmed.
